home.name: 427 Ridgewood Road
home.source: OSM/Nominatim building point, 2026-08-25 (same as APL Storytime)

bar: Equinox Austin Select ($250/mo quoted on the club page) is the floor. Country clubs sit above on initiation. KOKORO is below on price and is included as the closest Technogym + contrast gym — the commute control.
driveNote: Minutes are OSRM driving, uncongested, 2026-08-28. Peak toggle × 1.7 is a bound, not live traffic.

gyms.name: KOKORO Wellness
gyms.address: 5656 Bee Caves Road, Building K, Austin, TX 78746

price.note: Gym membership $125/mo; $175/mo with two InBody sessions. $25 weekday day pass.
price.source: The Practice at Westlake booking page

hours.weekday: Membership hours unpublished; day passes Mon–Fri 8am–5pm
hours.weekend: Day passes not sold on weekends

gyms.parking: Shopping-center lot on Bee Caves Road.

against: Very few public reviews
Day-pass visitors report empty front desk
Boutique floor, not an athletic country club

caveats: Price is below Equinox Select. Kept as the geographic control.
Yoga and recovery extras may be à la carte beyond the gym membership.
gyms.fitNote: Closest option. Useful if contrast therapy matters more than classes, pool, or travel clubs.

gyms.name: Life Time South Lamar
gyms.address: 1301 South Lamar Blvd Suite 100, Austin, TX 78704

price.note: Adult from $339/mo; month-to-month, 30-day cancel. Family add-ons change the bill. Newest Austin club; waitlist reported at launch.

gyms.parking: On-site at The Bouldin development; confirm garage rules on tour.

for: Co-ed wet suite: hot tub, plunge, hammam, sauna, steam
Kids Academy; ~125 weekly classes at launch
against: Highest Life Time starting dues in Austin
No lap pool on the club FAQ
Launch waitlist; Google-style reviews still thin

caveats: Wellhub 4.97 is a booking-platform score, not Google.
Opened 31 Dec 2025 / 1 Jan 2026 — crowding and class quality are still settling.
gyms.fitNote: Nearest full Life Time. Pays for new recovery + hours; skip if you need a lap pool.

gyms.name: Life Time Austin Downtown

price.note: Adult from $249/mo; month-to-month. Outdoor pool access may be a separate fee.

gyms.parking: On-site parking listed on public listings; confirm cost and time limits.

for: Seaholm / 5th Street — easy from West Austin without SoCo parking
against: Crowds at peaks
Sales pressure
Weekend close 7pm
Pool may not be in the base dues

caveats: Member site copy includes “Add Outdoor Pool Access” — treat the pool as extra until the club confirms.
Weekend hours match a downtown club, not an athletic country club.
gyms.fitNote: Best Equinox-priced Life Time on this commute if you skip the pool surcharge and finish by 7pm Saturday.

gyms.name: Equinox Austin
gyms.address: 1007 South Congress Avenue, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78704

price.note: Select (this club) $250/mo; All-Access 90+ clubs $350; Destination 110+ $370. Promo: 2 weeks + $0 initiation, ends 31 Aug 2026. Initiation is often $100–$500 when not waived.

gyms.parking: Shared garage. Reviews describe a 2.5-hour limit with tickets and no grace period.

for: Instructors transferred from other Equinox cities
against: Parking tickets after 2.5 hours
Weekend close 6pm
No pool
Public star mean sits near 3 because of billing and parking

caveats: Select plan copy lists “contrast therapy amenities”; the club amenity list names steam, not a plunge. Confirm on tour.
Austin has no E by Equinox. Destination ($370) is the travel tier.
gyms.fitNote: The namesake. Worth it for classes + travel clubs if you accept SoCo parking and 6pm weekend close.

gyms.name: Soho House Austin
gyms.address: 1011 S Congress, Building 2, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78704

price.note: $937.50 quarterly ($3,750/year = $312.50/mo). Under 27: $475 quarterly. Application, not a walk-up gym.

gyms.parking: SoCo; not a gym garage. Plan rideshare or street.

for: Rooftop pool and house social calendar
Gym + steam/sauna for members and hotel guests
against: Gym is an amenity of a members’ club, not Equinox-scale programming
Creative-industry application screen
Dues buy the House, not a training system

caveats: Next door to Equinox. If the gym is the product, Equinox is the direct comparison.
Soho Active guest rules vary by House.
gyms.fitNote: Only if you want the House. Do not join this for the gym alone.

gyms.name: Monroe

price.note: No public monthly quote. 1 Hotel extra guests: $35 day rate after a complimentary first pass. TDLR filing: 15,636 sq ft spa/members’ club remodel, completion listed 27 Apr 2026.
price.source: 1 Hotel Austin Mind & Movement; TDLR TABS2026000847

gyms.parking: South Austin street / hotel; confirm with concierge.

against: No public dues
Almost no public reviews
Members’ club, not a drop-in gym

caveats: Treat as Equinox-above only after they quote. Do not rank on price.
Ask whether membership is training-first or hospitality-first.
gyms.fitNote: Tour if you want a small private floor with recovery and PT under one roof — after they send a number.

gyms.name: Westlake Country Club

price.note: Keenan Group 2026-05/08: $100,000 initiation, $1,120/mo. Formerly Lost Creek. Invited (ClubCorp) network. 7,500 sq ft fitness reported in that guide.
price.source: Keenan Group Austin country clubs guide

for: Nearest private club to Ridgewood Road
against: Fitness is 7,500 sq ft — smaller than Barton Creek or The Hills
Dues buy golf/social, not a gym
Initiation is a five-to-six-figure decision

caveats: Ask for a social or sports membership if golf is not the point.
Figures are realtor field guidance, not a club invoice.
gyms.fitNote: If you already want a Westlake club, the gym is a bonus 12 minutes away. Do not join only for the floor.

gyms.name: Barton Creek Country Club

price.note: Keenan Group 2026-08-12: $125,000 initiation, $1,120/mo. Fitness is included in membership; Omni resort guests use a related fitness center.
price.source: Keenan Group Austin country clubs guide

hours.weekday: Member fitness hours unpublished; Omni lists a resort fitness desk at 512-329-4009

gyms.parking: Club / resort campus off Barton Club Drive.

for: Largest private-club fitness floor in Texas per the club (33,000 sq ft)
Indoor lap pool, indoor track, 40+ weekly classes
against: Gym is bundled with a golf/resort membership
Hours not posted
Initiation ~500× Equinox Select

caveats: Club copy: “largest fitness center at any private club in Texas.” That is a first-party claim, not a measured census.
Confirm whether a fitness-only path exists (unlikely).
gyms.fitNote: The serious private-club gym on this side of town. Only in play if the rest of Barton Creek is also the product.

gyms.name: Life Time Austin South

price.note: Adult from $259/mo; month-to-month. Pool/racquet access can carry extra terms.

gyms.parking: Surface lot off MoPac frontage; typical suburban Life Time.

for: True athletic country club: pool, pickleball, basketball, kids, LifeSpa
against: 13 minutes free-flow; MoPac south can stack at peaks
Less “boutique” than Equinox or South Lamar

caveats: Best Life Time on amenities-per-dollar from this house if you will use the pool and courts.
Club FAQ warns outdoor pool / racquet areas may take a supplemental fee.
gyms.fitNote: Default Life Time if you want a pool without a downtown surcharge and can live with a MoPac hop.

gyms.name: Austin Country Club

price.note: Keenan Group: $150,000+ initiation, $1,000+/mo, invitation, multi-year waitlist. Pete Dye course on Lake Austin. Fitness exists; the club does not publish a gym spec sheet.
price.source: Keenan Group Austin country clubs guide

gyms.parking: Member lot on Long Champ Drive.

for: Closest old-line private club to West Lake Hills
Tennis and pool as part of membership
against: Waitlist measured in years
Gym is not the published product
Invitation only

caveats: Do not treat ACC as an Equinox substitute. It is a golf/social club that happens to have a fitness room.
Amenity flags for the gym are conservative; tour if you have a path in.
gyms.fitNote: Ignore unless you are already pursuing ACC for golf or family. The gym will not beat Life Time or Equinox.

gyms.name: Life Time Austin Arboretum

price.note: Adult from $219/mo — lowest Life Time starting dues in this set.

gyms.parking: North Austin lot / garage at Braker.

against: 18 minutes free-flow north on MoPac
Weekend close 7pm
Fewer recovery features than South Lamar or Austin South

caveats: Only rational if you already spend time in the Domain / Braker belt, or as a Signature add-on.
gyms.fitNote: Skip as a home club from Ridgewood Road unless north Austin is your work pattern.

gyms.name: The Hills Country Club

price.note: Keenan Group: Signature golf $50,000 initiation, $825/mo; range on another page $40k–$80k / $500–$900. Social memberships exist without full golf. Fitness included in all levels.
price.source: Keenan Group Hills of Lakeway page; Invited membership page

gyms.parking: Lakeway campus lot. Pin is the Hills clubhouse; sports complex is on the same club.

for: 22,000 sq ft sports complex, Technogym + Cybex
against: 26 minutes free-flow to Lakeway
Gym still sits inside a golf club

caveats: Pin is 26 Club Estates Parkway (Hills clubhouse / Signature course), not a separate street address for the sports complex.
Ask Invited for current social vs golf pricing — realtor ranges disagree by tens of thousands.
gyms.fitNote: Strongest private athletic campus in this set, but it is a Lakeway drive. Only if Lakeway is already in the week.

gyms.name: Life Time Austin North

price.note: Adult from $219/mo. Indoor and outdoor pools, pickleball, basketball, Kids Academy.

against: Yelp 3.0/262 — typical Life Time mix of amenity praise and sales/crowd complaints
27 minutes free-flow from Ridgewood Road

caveats: Cedar Park Life Time (301 CR 178) is a future club, not open. Do not navigate there.
Home club from West Lake Hills only if 620 is already a commute.
gyms.fitNote: Fullest Life Time in the metro, longest drive. Use as a Signature satellite, not a home club.
